outcome: placental fatty acid profile (omega-3 fatty acids: ALA, EPA, DPA, DHA; omega-6/omega-3 ratios: AA/DHA, LA/ALA)
estimated desaturase (D9Dn7, D5Dn6) and elongase (Elovl5) activities in the placenta
cohort: Placentas from 84 term-born infants (45 appropriate-for-gestational-age and 30 small-for-gestational-age) were analyzed.
finding: Placentas from SGA infants showed lower levels of omega-3 fatty acids and higher omega-6/omega-3 ratios, along with low elongase and high desaturase activity, compared to AGA infants.
birth_weight: Infants classified as appropriate-for-gestational-age (AGA) or small-for-gestational-age (SGA)
